planned_by: Claude (Critic): external review — Meta tool use
goal:
T72 — the Critic on a SECOND Meta open-weight model (external review: "only the Builder uses a Meta model; run the
Critic / hidden-test generation on another Meta open model via Fireworks or Baseten"). API only; configured purely by env;
with the new env unset everything behaves exactly as today.
1. evoforge/critic.py: critic_endpoint() -> {"base_url", "model", "provider", "second"} where provider is the base URL's
   host (e.g. "api.fireworks.ai"). Second provider when CRITIC_API_BASE and CRITIC_API_KEY are both set (model from
   MODEL_CRITIC); otherwise today's MODEL_API_BASE (default https://api.meta.ai/v1) + MODEL_API_KEY, provider "api.meta.ai".
   Never put the key in the returned dict.
2. call_critic uses critic_endpoint(): openai.OpenAI(base_url=..., api_key=CRITIC_API_KEY or MODEL_API_KEY, max_retries=0)
   (construct it as openai.OpenAI so tests can substitute it); the result and every provider_calls entry carry
   "provider"; the key never appears in any output, log or error. With the second provider and
   CRITIC_PRICE_INPUT_PER_MTOK / CRITIC_PRICE_OUTPUT_PER_MTOK (USD per million tokens, set by the owner from the
   provider's price page — never guess prices) not both set: raise broker_meta.ProviderNotAccepted before creating any
   client (nothing sent, nothing billed). Keep the no-MODEL_API_KEY stub path as it is.
3. evoforge/performance.py: usage_cost_cents(usage, model=None) prices a call at the critic provider's prices when the
   second provider is configured and model == its MODEL_CRITIC (cache-read tokens at the input price); otherwise today's
   prices (EVO_PRICE_*). Add output_cost_cents(out) = usage_cost_cents(usage_from_output(out), model=out["model"]).
   Every place that costs a CRITIC output (sealed_eval critic-feedback path, the prompt-Arena judge and lane Critic,
   main.py review, evolution rounds) must pass the output's model (use output_cost_cents) so Critic tokens are never
   billed at Builder prices; Builder costs unchanged. Money stays integer cents (round up).
4. Fairness manifest (arena_prompt.build_manifest and arena.build_manifest): lanes.evoforge gets "critic_model" and
   "critic_provider"; the prompt manifest also gets top-level "judge_model" (the acceptance tests come from the Critic
   model). Both lanes' Builder model stays the same.
5. infra/gcp/deploy_prod.sh: nothing to change now (the owner adds the key/prices at submission); add a short comment
   listing the env names.
